fields.meta_title: Trip Report Form Builder, Free to Start | Emergent
fields.meta_description: Build a trip report form that records why each trip happened and what it found, sends follow-ups to their owners and reminds late filers.
fields.h1: Build a Trip Report Form Every Traveler Files the Same Way
fields.hero_description: Build a trip report form that records the purpose, findings and follow-ups of every trip in a database you own.
fields.features_heading: What a Trip Report Should Bring Home
fields.features_subheading: Reports written a week late lose names and decisions. Describe the trips you take, and Emergent builds the form and its database.
fields.feature_1:
Sections in the order a reader needs

The form asks for the reason for the trip, then what the traveler found, then the conclusions. Your manager reads the outcome without hunting through a page of travel notes.
fields.feature_2:
Follow-ups that carry a name and a date

Each conclusion can become a task with an owner and a due date. The owner gets an email with the task, and the report shows which follow-ups are still open a week later.
fields.feature_3:
Receipts photographed into the report

Photograph a fuel or hotel receipt, and the app reads the merchant, date, and total into fields. Any value it cannot read clearly goes back to the traveler to type in.
fields.feature_4:
A reminder for every late report

Set a filing deadline counted in days from the return date. Anyone past it gets an email reminder, and the team lead sees which reports are in and which are still missing.
fields.feature_5:
Every trip on file in one place

Each report saves to a database you own, so you can look up every visit to one client or every conference from last year. Filter the list by traveler, destination, or month.
fields.feature_6:
Your codebase on your own servers

On paid plans, export the full code to your GitHub repository and host it where your other internal tools run. Keep building on it from there, or keep changing it by prompt.

fields.hero_prompt: Build a trip report form my sales reps fill out after each client visit, with the people they met and a follow-up list where each task has an owner.

faq_plan.q: What is a trip report form?
How do I create a trip report form?

plan.angle: The results for this query are printable trip report templates (Visme, Venngage, Word and PDF downloads) and one form-tool template page. They stop at the blank fields. None shows a report that does something after it is filed: follow-ups that reach their owners, a reminder when a conference report is late, fuel receipts read into the report, an incident on a school trip that reaches the principal. This page shows a working trip report form for four kinds of trips, with every report saved to a database the organization owns, and states the trip report structure only as the MIT writing guide gives it.
tab_stories: At Saxelby Instruments, rep Tabitha Crouchmore files her Pomfrey Dairy visit report with 3 follow-ups, and each owner gets an email with the task and its due date.

At Drewsbury County Library, 4 staff attend a 3-day conference; one report is still missing 10 days after the return date, so Wystan Dimmock gets an email reminder while director Dorcas Ellerbeck sees which reports are in.

At Hartwyn Freight, driver Petronella Tiverton files run 2207 with 546 miles across 3 states, and a photo of a Joliet fuel receipt fills in 96.4 gallons and $348.90, with the unreadable date sent back to her.

At Ulmscott Middle School, teacher Clementine Mapplethorpe reports 52 students out and 52 back from the science museum, but the bus left 35 minutes late, so principal Anselm Trowbridge gets an email that day.
